stages.discovery: A handful of buildings cluster together off the road - a general store flanked by two modest houses, the closest thing to a hamlet this stretch of country has. Doors stand open. Nothing is burned, nothing is broken. It's simply empty, the way a room feels when everyone in it left mid-conversation.

choices.label: Search the Houses
choices.description: See what the residents left behind - Perception check

check.success_outcome: Meals sit half-eaten on tables, beds unmade, nothing packed for a journey. Whatever made these people leave, they didn't plan for it. You take what won't be missed and try not to think too hard about the rest.
check.failure_outcome: You go house to house but nothing worth taking has been left in plain sight, and you don't have the stomach to dig deeper into a stranger's abandoned home.

choices.label: Check the General Store's Ledger
choices.outcome: The last few pages mention rising prices, a bad harvest, and - in a hurried hand near the end - unfamiliar riders spotted on the north road. The entries just stop after that, no explanation, no goodbye.

choices.label: Leave the Hamlet Undisturbed
choices.description: ESC also cancels - whatever happened here, it isn't yours to pick apart
choices.outcome: You walk the empty lane between the houses without stepping inside a single one, and let the hamlet keep whatever answers it has left.
